action_items: NON-BLOCKING but recommended before the user re-runs `eas build`: `mobile/yarn.lock` is UNTRACKED in git (git ls-files says NOT_TRACKED; it is not gitignored - root .gitignore line 54 has 'yarn.lock' commented out, and frontend-next/yarn.lock IS tracked). If the user pulls the repo on their Windows machine without this lockfile, EAS/npm will resolve mobile deps fresh from package.json ranges instead of the frozen tree that expo-doctor just validated. The '~13.0.3' pin keeps it within SDK 51 so the Gradle error should still not recur, but commit mobile/yarn.lock to make the verified resolution reproducible on the EAS builder.
critical_code_review_comments: Root cause is confirmed and correctly fixed at the source (the version pin), not papered over: expo-module-gradle-plugin only exists in SDK 52+, so any SDK-54-era package on an SDK-51 project fails at Gradle configuration time and cascades into the 'unknown property release for SoftwareComponent container' error. Downgrading to the sdk-51 dist-tag pin ~13.0.3 removes the trigger entirely.

Preventive suggestion: add `npx expo-doctor` (or `npx expo install --check`) as a CI/pre-push gate for the mobile workspace. This class of SDK drift is invisible to `tsc --noEmit` (typecheck passed even while expo-web-browser was at ^57.0.2) and only surfaces ~20 minutes into a cloud Gradle build, which is an expensive feedback loop.

The '^' caret on the original pin is what allowed the drift. Expo's own convention of '~' for all expo-* packages is now consistently applied across every expo-* dependency in mobile/package.json - worth keeping as a rule for future additions.

rca_of_the_issue: RCA (confirmed, fix verified): mobile/package.json pinned expo-web-browser to '^57.0.2'. Version 57.x targets Expo SDK 54+, whose Android autolinking ships and expects the 'expo-module-gradle-plugin' Gradle plugin. The project is on Expo SDK 51 (expo ~51.0.28), where that plugin does not exist, so Gradle configuration failed with "Plugin 'expo-module-gradle-plugin' was not found"; because the module's build script then never registered its publishing components, Gradle cascaded into "Could not get unknown property release for SoftwareComponent container". Reproduction: any `eas build --platform android` on the SDK-51 project with expo-web-browser@57.x. Mitigation applied by the dev agent and verified here: pin to the sdk-51 dist-tag version ~13.0.3, reinstall so node_modules + yarn.lock reflect 13.0.3, and document the failure signature in EAS_BUILD_GUIDE.md. Post-fix evidence: expo-doctor 17/17 with zero warnings, tsc --noEmit exit 0, lockfile and installed tree both at 13.0.3, and no other dependency perturbed.
